guide.summary: 被 puts the thing affected first and the doer second: Receiver + 被 + doer + verb + what happened to it. The sentence is about the receiver and how it ended up, so the verb has to carry a result or 了, exactly as in a 把 sentence turned around. Chinese uses 被 far less than English uses 'was done': when a thing obviously cannot act by itself, the plain sentence (作业写完了) is already passive.

subs.label: Receiver + 被 + doer + verb
subs.focus: Force the order: receiver before 被, doer right after 被, all of it before the verb. Classic errors: 被 + doer after the verb like English 'by ...' (手机偷走了被小偷), or doer and receiver swapped. Make 被 and the doer separate tiles; in cloze, offer 把 and 给 as distractors.

subs.label: 被 with no doer; 被人
subs.focus: Decide whether the doer can be left out. After 被 it can (钱包被偷了), or use 人 for an unknown doer. After 叫/让 a doer is required: 让偷了 is wrong, 让人偷了 is right. Cloze: 被 against 叫/让 with no doer following. Judge: 叫/让 directly before the verb (wrong), 被 directly before the verb (correct trap).

subs.label: 没, 不会, 已经, 别 go before 被
subs.focus: Place 没, 不会, 会, 可能, 已经, 也, 都, 别 before 被, never between the doer and the verb. Also: a past event is negated with 没(有)被, not 不被, and 没 drops the final 了. Classic errors: 被没偷, 被老师会批评, 没被偷了. Make the negator or modal its own tile.

subs.label: The verb cannot stand bare
subs.focus: A one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence alone: it needs a result (完, 走, 坏, 破, 开), a direction, 到 + place, 得 + description, or at least 了. Classic error: 蛋糕被弟弟吃. Cloze: complement or 了 against ∅. Never mark a bare two-syllable verb after a modal as wrong (会被批评 is fine).

subs.label: Spoken 叫 / 让 for 被
subs.focus: Recognise 叫/让 as spoken passive markers: same order as 被, doer always stated (自行车让人骑走了). Keep it apart from 让/叫 'let, tell to': subject is the thing affected and the verb has a result. Errors: dropping the doer, reading 让 as 'let'. Never offer 被 and 叫/让 together when both fit.

subs.label: Passive without 被
subs.focus: Leave 被 out when a thing that cannot act is the subject, no doer is named and nothing bad happened: 作业写完了, 饭做好了. Error: 被 for every English 'was done'. The 被 version is odd, not impossible, so use cloze (被 vs ∅, cue asks for the natural sentence), 被 as an extra tile, or correct judge items only.

subs.label: 把 ⇄ 被 conversion
subs.focus: Convert both ways: 把 object becomes 被 subject, 把 subject becomes the doer after 被, everything from the verb on is unchanged, negation and modals stay before 把/被. Errors: keeping 把 inside the 被 sentence, losing the result. Mostly rewrite items; for 被 to 把 the source must name a doer.

rules.rule: Start with the thing or person affected, then 被, then who did it, then the verb with its result. The 被 phrase always comes before the verb.
rules.pattern: Receiver + 被 + Doer + Verb + result / 了

rules.note: 被 is most at home with things that are unwelcome for the receiver (stolen, broken, scolded), but neutral and good events are also normal in modern Chinese, especially in writing.

rules.rule: If you do not know or do not care who did it, put the verb right after 被, or use 人 for 'someone'.
rules.pattern: Receiver + 被 + (人) + Verb + result / 了

rules.note: Only 被 can do this. 叫 and 让 must be followed by a doer, even if it is just 人.

rules.rule: Negatives, modal verbs and adverbs go in front of 被. For something that did not happen use 没 or 没有, and leave out 了.
rules.pattern: Receiver + 没 / 不会 / 已经 / 也 + 被 + (Doer) + Verb + result

rules.note: 不被 exists, but for general or habitual statements (他不被大家理解, 'he is not understood by people'), not for a single past event.

rules.rule: To warn someone, put 别 before 被.
rules.pattern: 别 + 被 + Doer + Verb + 了 / result

rules.rule: After the verb, say how things ended up: a result word, a direction, 到 + place, or at least 了. A bare one-syllable verb cannot end the sentence.
rules.pattern: Receiver + 被 + (Doer) + Verb + 完 / 走 / 坏 / 开 / 到… + 了

rules.note: Two-syllable verbs are freer: after a modal or in formal style they can stand alone (会被批评, 被发现). For a finished single event they still take 了 or a result.

rules.rule: To describe the state something was left in, use Verb + 得 + description.
rules.pattern: Receiver + 被 + (Doer) + Verb + 得 + description

rules.rule: In everyday speech 叫 or 让 can replace 被. The order is the same, but the doer must be said.
rules.pattern: Receiver + 叫 / 让 + Doer + Verb + result / 了

rules.note: 让 and 叫 also mean 'let / tell someone to' (妈妈让我洗碗). It is passive when the subject is the thing affected and the verb has a result. In writing, use 被.

rules.rule: When the subject is a thing that plainly cannot do the action and you only report the result, use no 被 at all: thing + verb + result + 了.
rules.pattern: Thing + (已经 / 还没) + Verb + result + 了

rules.note: Adding 被 here is not strictly ungrammatical, but it sounds odd or suggests something unwanted. Use 被 when you name the doer, when something bad happened to the receiver, or when the subject is a person who could otherwise be taken as the doer (他打了 'he hit' against 他被打了 'he was hit').

rules.rule: 把 to 被: move the 把 object to the front, put the old subject after 被, and copy everything from the verb onward unchanged.
rules.pattern: Doer + 把 + Receiver + Verb + result  →  Receiver + 被 + Doer + Verb + result

rules.note: 把 and 被 never appear together for the same object in these sentences: pick one.

rules.rule: Negatives and modals keep their place in front: before 把 in the active sentence, before 被 in the passive one.
rules.pattern: Doer + 没 + 把 + Receiver + Verb + result  →  Receiver + 没 + 被 + Doer + Verb + result

contrasts.wrong: 我的手机偷走了被小偷。

right.zh: 我的手机被小偷偷走了。

right.en: My phone was stolen by a thief.

contrasts.why: English puts 'by a thief' at the end; Chinese puts 被 + doer before the verb.

right.py: dàn gāo bèi dì di chī wán le
right.en: The cake was eaten up by my little brother.

contrasts.why: A bare one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence; say what became of the cake with a result or 了.

right.py: wǒ de qián bāo méi bèi tōu zǒu

contrasts.why: 没 goes before 被, not between 被 and the verb.

right.py: wǒ de qián bāo méi bèi tōu zǒu

contrasts.why: 没 says it did not happen, so the completion 了 is dropped.

right.py: tā huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
right.en: He will be criticised by the teacher.

contrasts.why: Modal verbs such as 会 go before 被, not after the doer.

right.zh: 我的自行车让人骑走了。
right.py: wǒ de zì xíng chē ràng rén qí zǒu le
right.en: Someone rode off on my bike.

contrasts.why: 让 and 叫 need a doer after them. With no doer use 被 (被骑走了) or add 人.

right.py: dàn gāo bèi dì di chī wán le
right.en: The cake was finished by my little brother.

contrasts.why: When turning 把 into 被, 把 disappears: its object has already moved to the front.

right.py: fàn zuò hǎo le kuài lái chī ba
right.en: Dinner is ready, come and eat.

contrasts.why: Unnatural rather than impossible: food cannot cook, nothing bad happened and no doer is named, so Chinese leaves 被 out.

cheat: Receiver first, then 被 + doer, then the verb. Never 被 + doer at the end.
Verb in a 被 sentence needs a tail: result, direction, 得 or 了.
没 / 不会 / 会 / 已经 / 别 all go before 被; with 没, drop 了.
No doer? 被 works alone. 叫 and 让 need at least 人.
Thing that cannot act + result, no doer, nothing bad: skip 被 (作业写完了).
把 → 被: swap the two nouns, keep everything from the verb onward, delete 把.

items.py: dì di bǎ dàn gāo chī wán le

items.src: 我们不会把你的秘密说出去的。
items.src_py: wǒ men bù huì bǎ nǐ de mì mì shuō chū qù de

items.py: nǐ de mì mì bù huì bèi wǒ men shuō chū qù de

items.q: 他的外套被雨淋___全湿了。
items.zh: 他的外套被雨淋得全湿了。

items.q: 我的箱子被人拿___别的地方去了。

items.why: 到 + place gives the destination that completes the verb. 在 marks where an action happens, not where something ends up with 去了.

items.zh: 我的包被小偷偷走了。

items.en: My bag was stolen by a thief.
items.why: Receiver and doer are swapped. The thing affected goes before 被 and the doer after it.

items.en: My little brother drank up this cup of coffee.
items.why: Here 让 is passive (the coffee is the receiver), so the verb needs a result: 完. 着, 去 and 来 do not describe what became of the coffee.

items.py: bēi zi bèi dǎ pò le

items.zh: 水烧开了。

items.en: The water has boiled.
items.why: Water boils by itself and nothing was done to it by anyone, so the plain thing + verb + result + 了 is the natural passive. 被 would sound odd here.

items.q: 那辆旧汽车已经___卖给邻居了。
items.zh: 那辆旧汽车已经被卖给邻居了。

items.why: No doer is named, so only 被 can sit before the verb. 让 needs a doer right after it, and 把 or 向 do not form a passive.

items.q: 我们的车___交警拖走了，只好坐地铁回家。
items.zh: 我们的车被交警拖走了，只好坐地铁回家。
items.py: wǒ men de chē bèi jiāo jǐng tuō zǒu le zhǐ hǎo zuò dì tiě huí jiā
items.en: Our car was towed away by the traffic police, so we had to take the metro home.
items.why: The car is affected and the police are the doer, so 被 comes between them. 把 would make 我们的车 the doer.

items.s_py: nǐ bèi tā bié piàn le
items.zh: 你别被他骗了。
items.py: nǐ bié bèi tā piàn le
items.en: Don't let him fool you.
items.why: 别 goes before 被, not after the doer.

items.zh: 花瓶被妹妹打破了。
items.py: huā píng bèi mèi mei dǎ pò le
items.en: The vase was broken by my younger sister.
items.why: 被 and the doer sit before the verb; 打破 carries the result.

items.zh: 汤已经做好了。
items.py: tāng yǐ jīng zuò hǎo le
items.en: The soup is already made.
items.why: Reporting that the soup is ready needs no 被: thing + 已经 + verb + result + 了. 被 would suggest something was done to it by someone.

items.zh: 我的钱包没被小偷偷走。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo méi bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu
items.en: My wallet wasn't stolen by the thief.
items.why: 没 goes before 被, and with 没 there is no 了 at the end.

items.src: 司机把我们送到火车站了。
items.src_py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào huǒ chē zhàn le
items.zh: 我们被司机送到火车站了。
items.py: wǒ men bèi sī jī sòng dào huǒ chē zhàn le
items.en: We were taken to the train station by the driver.
items.why: The 把 object 我们 goes first, the driver after 被, and 送到火车站了 stays whole.

items.q: 你的衣服___洗好了，来拿吧。
items.zh: 你的衣服洗好了，来拿吧。
items.py: nǐ de yī fu xǐ hǎo le lái ná ba
items.en: Your clothes are washed, come and get them.
items.why: Clothes cannot wash themselves, no doer is named and nothing bad happened, so the natural sentence has no 被.

items.zh: 爸爸的车让邻居开到城里去了。
items.py: bà ba de chē ràng lín jū kāi dào chéng lǐ qù le
items.en: Dad's car was driven into town by a neighbour.
items.why: 让 + doer + verb with 到 + place. The doer comes before the verb, not after it.

items.s: 我的行李被送到了酒店。
items.s_py: wǒ de xíng li bèi sòng dào le jiǔ diàn
items.zh: 我的行李被送到了酒店。
items.py: wǒ de xíng li bèi sòng dào le jiǔ diàn
items.en: My luggage was delivered to the hotel.
items.why: Correct. 送到 + place supplies the result and 了 can follow 到.

items.zh: 你会被妈妈骂的。
items.py: nǐ huì bèi mā ma mà de
items.en: You'll get told off by Mum.
items.why: The modal 会 sits before 被, never between the doer and the verb.

items.s_py: nǐ bèi jǐng chá huì fá kuǎn de
items.zh: 你会被警察罚款的。
items.py: nǐ huì bèi jǐng chá fá kuǎn de
items.en: You'll be fined by the police.
items.why: The modal 会 goes before 被, not after the doer.

items.s_py: xiǎo gǒu jiào zhuàng shāng le
items.zh: 小狗叫车撞伤了。
items.py: xiǎo gǒu jiào chē zhuàng shāng le
items.en: The puppy was hit by a car and hurt.
items.why: 叫 as a passive marker needs the doer (车) right after it; only 被 can go straight before the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ de bāo bèi méi tōu zǒu
items.zh: 我的包没被偷走。
items.py: wǒ de bāo méi bèi tōu zǒu
items.en: My bag wasn't stolen.
items.why: 没 goes before 被, not between 被 and the verb.

items.src_py: dì di bǎ bēi zi dǎ pò le
items.zh: 杯子被弟弟打破了。
items.py: bēi zi bèi dì di dǎ pò le
items.en: The cup was broken by my little brother.
items.why: The 把 object moves to the front, the old subject follows 被, and 打破了 stays unchanged. 把 disappears.

items.zh: 我的钥匙被弟弟拿走了。
items.py: wǒ de yào shi bèi dì di ná zǒu le
items.en: My key was taken away by my little brother.
items.why: Receiver, then 被 + doer, then the verb with its result. The doer cannot trail the verb as English 'by' does.

items.s: 地铁票买好了，我们进站吧。
items.s_py: dì tiě piào mǎi hǎo le wǒ men jìn zhàn ba
items.zh: 地铁票买好了，我们进站吧。
items.py: dì tiě piào mǎi hǎo le wǒ men jìn zhàn ba
items.en: The metro tickets are bought, let's go in.
items.why: Correct. Tickets that are simply ready need no 被: thing + verb + result + 了.

items.src_py: mā ma bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng le
items.zh: 窗户被妈妈关上了。
items.py: chuāng hu bèi mā ma guān shàng le
items.en: The window was closed by Mum.
items.why: The window becomes the subject, Mum follows 被, and 关上了 is copied unchanged.

items.src_py: xiǎo tōu tōu le wǒ de qián bāo
items.task: Rewrite with 被 and leave out the thief.
items.zh: 我的钱包被偷了。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo bèi tōu le
items.en: My wallet was stolen.
items.why: After 被 the doer can be dropped, so the verb follows directly, with 了.

items.q: 晚饭___做好了，快来吃吧。
items.zh: 晚饭做好了，快来吃吧。
items.py: wǎn fàn zuò hǎo le kuài lái chī ba
items.en: Dinner is ready, come and eat.
items.why: Just reporting that food is ready: thing + verb + result + 了. Adding 被 suggests something was done to it by someone and sounds odd.

items.src_py: yī fu bèi yǔ lín shī le
items.task: Say it in spoken style with 叫.
items.zh: 衣服叫雨淋湿了。
items.py: yī fu jiào yǔ lín shī le
items.en: The clothes got soaked by the rain.
items.why: 叫 can replace 被 in speech as long as the doer (雨) is named.

items.q: 苹果被哥哥吃___。
items.zh: 苹果被哥哥吃了。
items.py: píng guǒ bèi gē ge chī le
items.en: The apple was eaten by my older brother.
items.why: A bare one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence; 了 is the minimum tail. Without it the sentence stops dead after 吃.

items.q: 小狗在路上___撞伤了。
items.zh: 小狗在路上被撞伤了。
items.py: xiǎo gǒu zài lù shàng bèi zhuàng shāng le
items.en: The puppy was hit and injured on the road.
items.why: With no doer stated, 被 goes straight before the verb. 叫 and 让 would need a doer (叫车撞伤了), and 把 cannot follow 小狗 here.

items.zh: 我被老师叫到办公室去了。
items.py: wǒ bèi lǎo shī jiào dào bàn gōng shì qù le
items.en: I was called to the office by the teacher.
items.why: 叫到 + place gives the verb its result; the 被 phrase stays before the verb.

items.s: 厨房已经被妈妈收拾干净了。
items.s_py: chú fáng yǐ jīng bèi mā ma shōu shi gān jìng le
items.zh: 厨房已经被妈妈收拾干净了。
items.py: chú fáng yǐ jīng bèi mā ma shōu shi gān jìng le
items.en: The kitchen has already been tidied up by Mum.
items.why: Correct. 已经 before 被, the doer named, and a result complement.

items.src_py: xiǎo tōu bèi jǐng chá zhuā zhù le
items.zh: 小偷可能被警察抓住了。
items.py: xiǎo tōu kě néng bèi jǐng chá zhuā zhù le
items.en: The thief may have been caught by the police.
items.why: 可能 goes before 被. It can also open the sentence.

items.q: 窗户被风吹___了。
items.zh: 窗户被风吹开了。
items.py: chuāng hu bèi fēng chuī kāi le
items.en: The window was blown open by the wind.
items.why: The result must say the window opened: 吹开. 走 would mean it was carried off, and 上 and 到 do not fit a window and wind.

items.src_py: yǒu rén ná zǒu le wǒ de sǎn
items.task: Rewrite with 被 and 人 (someone).
items.zh: 我的伞被人拿走了。
items.py: wǒ de sǎn bèi rén ná zǒu le
items.en: Someone took my umbrella.
items.why: An unknown doer is expressed with 人 after 被.

items.zh: 桌子上的蛋糕已经被弟弟吃完了。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng de dàn gāo yǐ jīng bèi dì di chī wán le
items.en: The cake on the table has already been eaten up by my little brother.
items.why: The adverb 已经 goes before 被, after the receiver.

items.q: 蛋糕___妹妹吃完了。
items.zh: 蛋糕被妹妹吃完了。
items.py: dàn gāo bèi mèi mei chī wán le
items.en: The cake was eaten up by my younger sister.
items.why: The cake comes first and the eater after the marker, so 被 is needed. 把 only works when the doer is the subject (妹妹把蛋糕吃完了).

items.q: 我的作业___老师收走了。
items.zh: 我的作业被老师收走了。
items.py: wǒ de zuò yè bèi lǎo shī shōu zǒu le
items.en: My homework was collected by the teacher.
items.why: The homework is the receiver at the front, so 被 introduces the teacher. 把 would need the teacher to be the subject.

items.zh: 别被车撞到了。
items.py: bié bèi chē zhuàng dào le
items.en: Don't get hit by a car.
items.why: A warning puts 别 before 被, not after the doer.

items.src_py: xiǎo gǒu bǎ shā fā yǎo huài le
items.zh: 沙发被小狗咬坏了。
items.py: shā fā bèi xiǎo gǒu yǎo huài le
items.en: The sofa was chewed up by the puppy.
items.why: The sofa takes the front, 小狗 follows 被, and 咬坏了 is unchanged.

items.src: 小偷把他的钱包偷走了。
items.src_py: xiǎo tōu bǎ tā de qián bāo tōu zǒu le
items.zh: 他的钱包被小偷偷走了。
items.py: tā de qián bāo bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu le
items.en: His wallet was stolen by the thief.
items.why: Object to the front, thief after 被, verb part unchanged.

items.s: 我的手机没被弟弟弄坏。
items.s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi dì di nòng huài
items.zh: 我的手机没被弟弟弄坏。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi dì di nòng huài
items.en: My phone wasn't broken by my little brother.
items.why: Correct. 没 is before 被 and there is no 了.

items.s: 我的蛋糕让哥哥吃光了。
items.s_py: wǒ de dàn gāo ràng gē ge chī guāng le
items.zh: 我的蛋糕让哥哥吃光了。
items.py: wǒ de dàn gāo ràng gē ge chī guāng le
items.en: My cake was eaten up by my older brother.
items.why: Correct. 让 is the spoken passive here: the cake is the receiver, the doer is named and the verb has a result.

items.zh: 我的帽子被风吹走了。
items.py: wǒ de mào zi bèi fēng chuī zǒu le
items.en: My hat was blown away by the wind.
items.why: 被 takes the doer 风 and goes before the verb, with the hat already at the front. 把 is not used in this order.

items.q: 别___他骗了，他不是好人。
items.zh: 别被他骗了，他不是好人。
items.py: bié bèi tā piàn le tā bù shì hǎo rén
items.en: Don't be fooled by him, he isn't a good person.
items.why: A warning is 别 + 被 + doer + verb. 把 would make 他 the one doing the fooling to a missing object, and 向 or 对 do not make a passive.

items.src_py: dì di xǐ huài le wǒ de máo yī
items.zh: 我的毛衣被弟弟洗坏了。
items.py: wǒ de máo yī bèi dì di xǐ huài le
items.en: My sweater was ruined in the wash by my little brother.
items.why: The result 坏 stays on the verb: 洗坏了 must go after the doer.

items.src_py: wǒ de shū méi bèi dì di nòng huài
items.zh: 弟弟没把我的书弄坏。
items.py: dì di méi bǎ wǒ de shū nòng huài
items.en: My little brother didn't break my book.
items.why: Going back to 把, the doer is the subject and 没 stays right before 把. There is no 了.

items.zh: 妹妹的蛋糕叫弟弟吃光了。
items.py: mèi mei de dàn gāo jiào dì di chī guāng le
items.en: My little sister's cake was eaten up by my little brother.
items.why: 叫 is the spoken passive marker here, followed by the doer and a verb with the result 光.

items.q: 他被送___医院去了。
items.zh: 他被送到医院去了。
items.py: tā bèi sòng dào yī yuàn qù le
items.en: He was taken to hospital.
items.why: Direction toward a destination is 到 + place, which supplies the result a 被 verb needs. 在 would not mean arriving, and 着 does not take a place.

items.q: 昨天我的伞没被人拿走___。
items.zh: 昨天我的伞没被人拿走。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ de sǎn méi bèi rén ná zǒu
items.en: My umbrella wasn't taken yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the event did not happen, so the completion 了 is dropped. 昨天 fixes a single past event, which rules out 了 here.

items.src: 孩子们把房间弄得很乱。
items.src_py: hái zi men bǎ fáng jiān nòng de hěn luàn
items.zh: 房间被孩子们弄得很乱。
items.py: fáng jiān bèi hái zi men nòng de hěn luàn
items.en: The room was left in a mess by the children.
items.why: Everything from the verb on (弄得很乱) is copied; only the two nouns swap and 把 becomes 被.

items.src_py: wǒ de shū bèi gē ge jiè zǒu le
items.task: Say it in spoken style with 让.
items.zh: 我的书让哥哥借走了。
items.py: wǒ de shū ràng gē ge jiè zǒu le
items.en: My book was borrowed by my older brother.
items.why: 让 replaces 被 in speech; the order is unchanged and the doer is kept.

items.s: 在地铁里，他的手机被人偷走了。
items.s_py: zài dì tiě lǐ tā de shǒu jī bèi rén tōu zǒu le
items.zh: 在地铁里，他的手机被人偷走了。
items.py: zài dì tiě lǐ tā de shǒu jī bèi rén tōu zǒu le
items.en: His phone was stolen on the metro.
items.why: Correct. The place phrase opens the sentence and 被人 + verb + result follows the receiver.

items.src_py: wǒ de qián bāo bèi rén tōu zǒu le
items.task: Say it in spoken style with 让.
items.zh: 我的钱包让人偷走了。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo ràng rén tōu zǒu le
items.en: Someone stole my wallet.
items.why: With 让 the doer cannot be dropped, so 人 stays.

items.zh: 我们的车被堵在路上了。
items.py: wǒ men de chē bèi dǔ zài lù shàng le
items.en: Our car got stuck in the traffic on the road.
items.why: 堵在路上 gives the verb its result (stuck on the road), after 被 with no doer.

items.s_py: yī fu bèi mā ma xǐ
items.zh: 衣服被妈妈洗干净了。
items.py: yī fu bèi mā ma xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: The clothes were washed clean by Mum.
items.why: A bare one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence; it needs a result and 了.

items.zh: 弟弟把我的玩具弄坏了。
items.py: dì di bǎ wǒ de wán jù nòng huài le
items.en: My little brother broke my toy.
items.why: The doer is the subject, so 把 moves the toy before the verb: doer + 把 + object + verb + 了.

items.src_py: fēng chuī kāi le mén
items.zh: 门被风吹开了。
items.py: mén bèi fēng chuī kāi le
items.en: The door was blown open by the wind.
items.why: The result 开 stays attached to the verb: 被风吹开了.

items.src_py: yǒu rén bǎ dēng guān shàng le
items.task: Rewrite with 被 and 人 (someone).
items.zh: 灯被人关上了。
items.py: dēng bèi rén guān shàng le
items.en: The light was switched off by someone.
items.why: The 把 object goes first, 人 follows 被, and 关上了 is copied. 把 disappears.

items.s: 我家门口的自行车被偷了。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā mén kǒu de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le
items.zh: 我家门口的自行车被偷了。
items.py: wǒ jiā mén kǒu de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le
items.en: The bike outside my home was stolen.
items.why: Correct. After 被 the doer may be dropped, so the verb follows directly, with 了.

items.q: 还好，我的钱包___被偷走。
items.zh: 还好，我的钱包没被偷走。
items.py: hái hǎo wǒ de qián bāo méi bèi tōu zǒu
items.en: Luckily my wallet wasn't stolen.
items.why: A past event that did not happen is negated with 没 before 被. 不 is for habits or general statements, and 别 is a warning, so neither fits a plain report.

items.s_py: chuāng hu bèi gē ge bǎ dǎ kāi le
items.zh: 窗户被哥哥打开了。
items.py: chuāng hu bèi gē ge dǎ kāi le
items.en: The window was opened by my older brother.
items.why: When the object is already at the front with 被, 把 is not used for it.

items.src_py: wǒ de xíng li bèi tōu zǒu le
items.task: Make it negative: it did not happen.
items.zh: 我的行李没被偷走。
items.py: wǒ de xíng li méi bèi tōu zǒu
items.en: My luggage wasn't stolen.
items.why: 没 goes before 被 and the final 了 is dropped.

items.q: 咖啡已经___泡好了，你进来喝吧。
items.zh: 咖啡已经泡好了，你进来喝吧。
items.py: kā fēi yǐ jīng pào hǎo le nǐ jìn lái hē ba
items.en: The coffee is already made, come in and have some.
items.why: Telling someone the coffee is ready needs no 被: no doer is named and it is not an unwanted event. 被 would sound odd.

items.s: 那个花瓶没被孩子们打碎。
items.s_py: nà ge huā píng méi bèi hái zi men dǎ suì
items.zh: 那个花瓶没被孩子们打碎。
items.py: nà ge huā píng méi bèi hái zi men dǎ suì
items.en: That vase wasn't smashed by the children.
items.why: Correct. 没被 with a result verb and no 了 is the mirror of 没把.

items.q: 哥哥___我的电脑修好了。
items.zh: 哥哥把我的电脑修好了。
items.py: gē ge bǎ wǒ de diàn nǎo xiū hǎo le
items.en: My older brother fixed my computer.
items.why: The doer 哥哥 is the subject, so 把 brings the computer before the verb. 被 would reverse the roles.

items.src: 报纸被爷爷拿到房间里去了。
items.src_py: bào zhǐ bèi yé ye ná dào fáng jiān lǐ qù le
items.zh: 爷爷把报纸拿到房间里去了。
items.py: yé ye bǎ bào zhǐ ná dào fáng jiān lǐ qù le
items.en: Grandpa took the newspaper into his room.
items.why: Swap the nouns: doer first, 把 + newspaper, and the whole verb tail 拿到房间里去了 stays together.

items.src: 我的手机被弟弟弄坏了。
items.src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi dì di nòng huài le
items.zh: 我的手机已经被弟弟弄坏了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī yǐ jīng bèi dì di nòng huài le
items.en: My phone has already been broken by my little brother.
items.why: 已经 goes before 被, never between the doer and the verb.

items.q: 我的词典让___借走了。
items.zh: 我的词典让小王借走了。
items.py: wǒ de cí diǎn ràng xiǎo wáng jiè zǒu le
items.en: My dictionary was borrowed by Xiao Wang.
items.why: Spoken 让 is a passive marker only with a doer right after it. Leaving the doer out (让借走了) is not possible; only 被 can drop it.

items.q: 蛋糕被弟弟吃___了。
items.zh: 蛋糕被弟弟吃完了。
items.py: dàn gāo bèi dì di chī wán le
items.en: The cake was finished off by my little brother.
items.why: The cake ended up gone, so the verb takes the result 完. 着 gives an ongoing state, and 过 would be 'has been eaten before'.

items.src: 邻居的孩子把我们家的窗户打破了。
items.src_py: lín jū de hái zi bǎ wǒ men jiā de chuāng hu dǎ pò le
items.zh: 我们家的窗户让邻居的孩子打破了。
items.py: wǒ men jiā de chuāng hu ràng lín jū de hái zi dǎ pò le
items.en: Our window was broken by the neighbour's child.
items.why: The window comes first and the neighbour's child follows 让. 打破了 is unchanged.

items.zh: 作业写完了。
items.py: zuò yè xiě wán le
items.en: The homework is done.
items.why: The homework cannot write itself and nothing bad happened, so it is plain thing + verb + result + 了. 被 is not used.

items.src_py: dà yǔ bǎ mǎ lù yān mò le
items.zh: 马路被大雨淹没了。
items.py: mǎ lù bèi dà yǔ yān mò le
items.en: The road was flooded by the heavy rain.
items.why: The 把 object moves to the front and the rain follows 被; 淹没了 stays as it is.

items.s_py: tā huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
items.zh: 他会被老师批评的。
items.py: tā huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
items.en: He will be criticised by the teacher.
items.why: Correct. 会 stands before 被, and the two-syllable verb 批评 is fine after a modal.

items.zh: 放心你的车不会被拖走的。
items.py: fàng xīn nǐ de chē bù huì bèi tuō zǒu de
items.en: Don't worry, your car won't be towed away.
items.why: 不会 goes before 被, and 的 closes the prediction.

items.src_py: diàn nǎo bèi gē ge xiū hǎo le
items.task: Say it has not happened yet (还没).
items.zh: 电脑还没被哥哥修好。
items.py: diàn nǎo hái méi bèi gē ge xiū hǎo
items.en: The computer hasn't been fixed by my older brother yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 被 and replaces 了.

items.src_py: nǐ bèi nà ge sī jī piàn le
items.task: Warn the listener not to let it happen (别).
items.zh: 别被那个司机骗了。
items.py: bié bèi nà ge sī jī piàn le
items.en: Don't let that driver fool you.
items.why: 别 goes before 被. 你 is dropped in a warning.

items.zh: 我的电脑被弟弟弄坏了。
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo bèi dì di nòng huài le
items.en: My computer was broken by my little brother.
items.why: Receiver first, then 被 + doer, then the verb with its result. 弟弟 cannot go after 弄坏了 the way English puts 'by my brother' at the end.

items.s: 我的电脑没被病毒感染。
items.s_py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn
items.zh: 我的电脑没被病毒感染。
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn
items.en: My computer wasn't infected by a virus.
items.why: 没 before 被 is correct, and with 没 there is no 了. The two-syllable verb 感染 can stand alone here.

items.s_py: nǐ bèi lǎo shī huì fā xiàn de
items.zh: 你会被老师发现的。
items.py: nǐ huì bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn de
items.en: The teacher will catch you.
items.why: Modal 会 goes before 被, not after the doer.

items.src_py: wǎng luò yǐ jīng bèi xiū hǎo le
items.task: Say it naturally, with no 被.
items.zh: 网络已经修好了。
items.py: wǎng luò yǐ jīng xiū hǎo le
items.en: The network has already been fixed.
items.why: When you only report that a thing is now fixed, no 被 is needed. 已经 stays before the verb.

items.s: 同学被我的词典借走了。
items.s_py: tóng xué bèi wǒ de cí diǎn jiè zǒu le
items.zh: 我的词典被同学借走了。
items.py: wǒ de cí diǎn bèi tóng xué jiè zǒu le
items.en: My dictionary was borrowed by a classmate.
items.why: The receiver comes before 被 and the doer after it. Here they are swapped, so the dictionary borrowed the classmate.

items.q: 我的药___弟弟吃光了，现在得再去买。
items.zh: 我的药让弟弟吃光了，现在得再去买。
items.py: wǒ de yào ràng dì di chī guāng le xiàn zài děi zài qù mǎi
items.en: My little brother ate up all my medicine, so I have to buy more now.
items.why: 让 + doer 弟弟 + result 光 makes the passive. 把 would turn the medicine into the one eating, and 向 or 对 do not introduce a doer.

items.s_py: tā bù bèi dà jiā lǐ jiě
items.zh: 他不被大家理解。
items.py: tā bù bèi dà jiā lǐ jiě
items.en: He isn't understood by anyone.
items.why: 不 before 被 is fine for a general state like this one, and the two-syllable verb 理解 can stand bare. Only a single past event needs 没.

items.s_py: wǒ de diàn nǎo jiào tōu zǒu le
items.zh: 我的电脑叫人偷走了。
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo jiào rén tōu zǒu le
items.en: Someone stole my computer.
items.why: 叫 must be followed by a doer, even if only 人. Only 被 can go straight before the verb.

items.q: 我的电脑___偷了，里面有我的作业。
items.zh: 我的电脑被偷了，里面有我的作业。
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo bèi tōu le lǐ miàn yǒu wǒ de zuò yè
items.en: My computer was stolen, and my homework was on it.
items.why: No doer is named, and only 被 can stand directly in front of the verb. 叫 and 让 need a doer after them, and 把 needs an object.

items.q: 我的手机___妈妈收走了，一个星期后才还给我。
items.zh: 我的手机被妈妈收走了，一个星期后才还给我。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi mā ma shōu zǒu le yí gè xīng qī hòu cái huán gěi wǒ
items.en: My phone was confiscated by Mom, and I only got it back a week later.
items.why: The phone is the receiver and Mom the doer, so 被 comes between them. 把 would make the phone the confiscator.

items.src: 你的电脑被病毒感染了。
items.src_py: nǐ de diàn nǎo bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn le
items.zh: 你的电脑可能会被病毒感染。
items.py: nǐ de diàn nǎo kě néng huì bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn
items.en: Your computer might get infected by a virus.
items.why: 可能 and 会 go before 被 as a block, either after the subject or at the very front. 了 is dropped because the event has not happened.

items.src: 我的照片被别人转发了。
items.src_py: wǒ de zhào piàn bèi bié rén zhuǎn fā le
items.zh: 我的照片让别人转发了。
items.py: wǒ de zhào piàn ràng bié rén zhuǎn fā le
items.en: My photo was forwarded by other people.
items.why: 让 takes the place of 被 and the doer 别人 is kept before the verb.

items.q: 他没___病毒感染，是因为一直开着杀毒软件。
items.zh: 他没被病毒感染，是因为一直开着杀毒软件。
items.py: tā méi bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn shì yīn wèi yì zhí kāi zhe shā dú ruǎn jiàn
items.en: He wasn't infected by the virus because he always kept antivirus software running.
items.why: 没 goes before 被, and 病毒 is the doer. 把 would say he did not infect the virus, which reverses the roles.

items.src: 孩子的手机被爸爸收走了。
items.src_py: hái zi de shǒu jī bèi bà ba shōu zǒu le
items.zh: 爸爸把孩子的手机收走了。
items.py: bà ba bǎ hái zi de shǒu jī shōu zǒu le
items.en: Dad took away the child's phone.
items.why: The doer 爸爸 becomes the subject and the receiver follows 把. Everything from the verb on is unchanged.

items.zh: 药被妈妈放在桌子上了。
items.py: yào bèi mā ma fàng zài zhuō zi shang le
items.en: The medicine was put on the table by Mom.
items.why: The doer 妈妈 sits between 被 and the verb phrase, and 放在桌子上 stays together with 了 after it. Putting 妈妈 at the end is the English order.

items.zh: 他的伤口被医生处理得很干净。
items.py: tā de shāng kǒu bèi yī shēng chǔ lǐ de hěn gān jìng
items.en: His wound was cleaned up well by the doctor.
items.why: 被 + 医生 comes before the verb, and 得 + description follows it. Adding the doer after the description is the English order.

items.src_py: tā bèi zhuàng dǎo le
items.zh: 他被车撞倒了。
items.py: tā bèi chē zhuàng dǎo le
items.en: He was knocked down by a car.
items.why: The doer goes between 被 and the verb, not at the end after 了.

items.src_py: zuò yè yǐ jīng bèi xiě wán le
items.task: Say it naturally, with no 被.
items.zh: 作业已经写完了。
items.py: zuò yè yǐ jīng xiě wán le
items.en: The homework is already done.
items.why: Homework cannot act and no doer is named. Chinese reports the result with no 被.

items.src_py: wǒ de yào bèi dì di chī wán le
items.zh: 弟弟把我的药吃完了。
items.py: dì di bǎ wǒ de yào chī wán le
items.en: My little brother finished off my medicine.
items.why: Turn the doer into the subject and move the receiver after 把; the verb 吃完了 stays exactly as it was.

items.q: 还好，我的手机___被弟弟摔坏。
items.zh: 还好，我的手机没被弟弟摔坏。
items.py: hái hǎo wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi dì di shuāi huài
items.en: Luckily my phone didn't get dropped and broken by my little brother.
items.why: One past event that did not happen is negated with 没 placed before 被. 不 is for habits, 别 is a command, and 会 would say it will happen.

items.src: 我的电脑没被同事用坏。
items.src_py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi tóng shì yòng huài
items.zh: 同事没把我的电脑用坏。
items.py: tóng shì méi bǎ wǒ de diàn nǎo yòng huài
items.en: My colleague didn't ruin my computer by using it.
items.why: The doer 同事 becomes the subject, 没 stays before the marker, now 把, and the receiver follows 把.

items.zh: 我的耳机被人拿走了。
items.py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi rén ná zǒu le
items.en: Someone took my earphones.
items.why: 人 stands for an unknown doer and stays between 被 and the verb. 被人 is the usual way to say 'someone did it'.

items.s: 你的体检报告已经打印好了，在前台。
items.s_py: nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào yǐ jīng dǎ yìn hǎo le zài qián tái
items.zh: 你的体检报告已经打印好了，在前台。
items.py: nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào yǐ jīng dǎ yìn hǎo le zài qián tái
items.en: Your checkup report has been printed; it's at the front desk.
items.why: A thing plus its result and 了 already carries the passive meaning, so no 被 is needed. The sentence is correct as it stands.

items.src: 小偷把他的手机偷走了。
items.src_py: xiǎo tōu bǎ tā de shǒu jī tōu zǒu le
items.zh: 他的手机被小偷偷走了。
items.py: tā de shǒu jī bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu le
items.en: The thief stole his phone.
items.why: The phone goes first, the thief follows 被, and 偷走了 is copied over. Do not leave 把 behind.

items.q: 小声点儿，___被老师发现了。
items.zh: 小声点儿，别被老师发现了。
items.py: xiǎo shēng diǎn r bié bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn le
items.en: Keep your voice down, don't let the teacher catch us.
items.why: To warn someone, put 别 before 被. 没 or 已经 would report a fact, which does not fit a warning to keep quiet.

items.zh: 你别被陌生人骗了。
items.py: nǐ bié bèi mò shēng rén piàn le
items.en: Don't let strangers fool you.
items.why: A warning puts 别 before 被, then the doer 陌生人, then the verb. 别 cannot come after the doer.

items.q: 我的电脑没___他弄坏，是我自己弄坏的。
items.zh: 我的电脑没被他弄坏，是我自己弄坏的。
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi tā nòng huài shì wǒ zì jǐ nòng huài de
items.en: My computer wasn't broken by him; I broke it myself.
items.why: The computer is the receiver, so 没 + 被 + 他 + 弄坏. 把 would make the computer the doer that did not break him, which makes no sense.

items.s: 这种病毒不会被杀毒软件发现。
items.s_py: zhè zhǒng bìng dú bú huì bèi shā dú ruǎn jiàn fā xiàn
items.zh: 这种病毒不会被杀毒软件发现。
items.py: zhè zhǒng bìng dú bú huì bèi shā dú ruǎn jiàn fā xiàn
items.en: This kind of virus won't be detected by antivirus software.
items.why: 不会 goes before 被, and after a modal a two-syllable verb like 发现 can stand without 了 or a result.

items.src: 医生检查完了他的眼睛。
items.src_py: yī shēng jiǎn chá wán le tā de yǎn jing
items.task: Make 他的眼睛 the subject with 被.
items.zh: 他的眼睛被医生检查完了。
items.py: tā de yǎn jing bèi yī shēng jiǎn chá wán le
items.en: The doctor finished examining his eyes.
items.why: The receiver comes first and 医生 follows 被. 检查完了 carries the result so the verb is not bare.

items.src: 我的手机被同学借走了。
items.src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tóng xué jiè zǒu le
items.zh: 我的手机叫同学借走了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī jiào tóng xué jiè zǒu le
items.en: My phone was borrowed by a classmate.
items.why: 叫 replaces 被 in the same slot, with the doer 同学 still required right after it.

items.zh: 我的眼镜被妹妹踩坏了。
items.py: wǒ de yǎn jìng bèi mèi mei cǎi huài le
items.en: My glasses were stepped on and broken by my little sister.
items.why: Receiver, then 被 + doer, then the verb with its result. Once the object is in front there is no 把.

items.src_py: wǒ men bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn le
items.zh: 我们没被老师发现。
items.py: wǒ men méi bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn
items.en: We weren't found out by the teacher.
items.why: 没 sits in front of 被, not before the verb, and 了 is dropped.

items.s_py: wǒ de chōng diàn bǎo ràng jiè zǒu le
items.zh: 我的充电宝让人借走了。
items.py: wǒ de chōng diàn bǎo ràng rén jiè zǒu le
items.en: Someone borrowed my power bank.
items.why: 让 used as a passive marker must be followed by a doer. Without 人 or a name, 让 has nobody to be the doer.

items.s: 我被蚊子咬得睡不着觉。
items.s_py: wǒ bèi wén zi yǎo de shuì bù zháo jiào
items.zh: 我被蚊子咬得睡不着觉。
items.py: wǒ bèi wén zi yǎo de shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: I was bitten by mosquitoes so badly I couldn't sleep.
items.why: 咬得 + description is a valid way to give the result of the verb in a 被 sentence, so nothing is missing.

items.src_py: mā ma guān diào le wǒ de diàn nǎo
items.task: Make 我的电脑 the subject with 被.
items.zh: 我的电脑被妈妈关掉了。
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo bèi mā ma guān diào le
items.en: Mom switched off my computer.
items.why: Move the object to the front, put the doer after 被, and keep the result 掉 and 了 on the verb.

items.s_py: tāng zuò hǎo le kuài lái hē ba
items.zh: 汤做好了，快来喝吧。
items.py: tāng zuò hǎo le kuài lái hē ba
items.en: The soup is ready, come and drink it.
items.why: Soup cannot cook itself and nothing bad happened, so there is no 被. The sentence is already passive in meaning.

items.src: 我的检查结果没被医生弄错。
items.src_py: wǒ de jiǎn chá jié guǒ méi bèi yī shēng nòng cuò
items.zh: 医生没把我的检查结果弄错。
items.py: yī shēng méi bǎ wǒ de jiǎn chá jié guǒ nòng cuò
items.en: The doctor didn't get my test results wrong.
items.why: The doctor becomes the subject, 没 stays before the marker, now 把, and the verb phrase 弄错 is unchanged.

items.zh: 你上课玩手机会被老师批评的。
items.py: nǐ shàng kè wán shǒu jī huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
items.en: You'll get criticised by the teacher if you play on your phone in class.
items.why: Modal 会 goes before 被, not after the doer. 被老师会批评 is the classic mistake.

items.q: 雨已经___停了，我们出发吧。
items.zh: 雨已经停了，我们出发吧。
items.py: yǔ yǐ jīng tíng le wǒ men chū fā ba
items.en: The rain has already stopped, so let's set off.
items.why: 停 here is something the rain does by itself; nobody acts on it, so there is no receiver-doer pair and no 被.

items.s_py: tā de shǒu bèi dāo huá
items.zh: 他的手被刀划破了。
items.py: tā de shǒu bèi dāo huá pò le
items.en: His hand was cut by a knife.
items.why: 划 is bare here and cannot end the sentence. It needs a result such as 破 plus 了.

items.zh: 他被感冒折磨得睡不着觉。
items.py: tā bèi gǎn mào zhé mó de shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: He was tormented by his cold so badly that he couldn't sleep.
items.why: The state left behind is described with 得 after the verb. 被感冒 precedes 折磨得, and the description comes last.

items.src_py: tā bèi wǒ chuán rǎn le
items.zh: 他没被我传染。
items.py: tā méi bèi wǒ chuán rǎn
items.en: He wasn't infected by me.
items.why: Past negation uses 没 before 被, and 了 is removed. 被没我传染 is the wrong place for 没.

items.zh: 他的病情已经被医生控制住了。
items.py: tā de bìng qíng yǐ jīng bèi yī shēng kòng zhì zhù le
items.en: His condition has already been brought under control by the doctors.
items.why: The adverb 已经 goes before 被. 被医生已经控制住了 puts it in the wrong slot.

items.q: 手机的电已经___用完了。
items.zh: 手机的电已经用完了。
items.py: shǒu jī de diàn yǐ jīng yòng wán le
items.en: The phone's battery has already run out.
items.why: The battery is a thing that cannot act and no doer matters, so Chinese just reports the result. 被 here would sound odd, as if someone had used it up on purpose.

items.src_py: nǐ bèi wǎng shàng de guǎng gào piàn le
items.task: Tell the person not to let it happen.
items.zh: 别被网上的广告骗了。
items.py: bié bèi wǎng shàng de guǎng gào piàn le
items.en: Don't be fooled by online ads.
items.why: 别 goes before 被 and the subject 你 is dropped in a command. 了 stays here to mean 'don't end up fooled'.

items.q: 我的耳机被弟弟弄___了。
items.zh: 我的耳机被弟弟弄坏了。
items.py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi dì di nòng huài le
items.en: My earphones got broken by my little brother.
items.why: 弄 cannot end the sentence alone; it needs a result, and 坏 gives 'broken'. 弄去 is not a word, and 过 or 着 would not give the broken result.

items.src: 妈妈把我的感冒药扔了。
items.src_py: mā ma bǎ wǒ de gǎn mào yào rēng le
items.zh: 我的感冒药被妈妈扔了。
items.py: wǒ de gǎn mào yào bèi mā ma rēng le
items.en: Mom threw away my cold medicine.
items.why: Swap the nouns around 被, delete 把, and keep 扔了. 了 is what lets this one-syllable verb end the sentence.

items.s_py: yào bèi mā ma rēng
items.zh: 药被妈妈扔了。
items.py: yào bèi mā ma rēng le
items.en: The medicine was thrown away by Mom.
items.why: A one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence bare. It needs 了 or a result.

items.src: 小王把我的手机摔坏了。
items.src_py: xiǎo wáng bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī shuāi huài le
items.zh: 我的手机被小王摔坏了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi xiǎo wáng shuāi huài le
items.en: Xiao Wang dropped and broke my phone.
items.why: Move the 把 object to the front, put the old subject after 被, and keep the verb with its result and 了 unchanged.

items.src_py: tā bèi tóng xué men wù huì le
items.task: Say it won't happen, ending with 的.
items.zh: 他不会被同学们误会的。
items.py: tā bù huì bèi tóng xué men wù huì de
items.en: His classmates won't misunderstand him.
items.why: 不会 goes before 被 for a prediction, and 的 replaces 了. The two-syllable verb 误会 can stand bare after a modal.

items.src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu zǒu le
items.zh: 我的手机没被偷走。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi tōu zǒu
items.en: My phone wasn't stolen.
items.why: 没 goes before 被, and the final 了 is dropped because 没 already says it did not happen.

items.q: 昨天很多用户的账号___盗了，公司正在调查。
items.zh: 昨天很多用户的账号被盗了，公司正在调查。
items.py: zuó tiān hěn duō yòng hù de zhàng hào bèi dào le gōng sī zhèng zài diào chá
items.en: Many users' accounts were hacked yesterday, and the company is investigating.
items.why: No hacker is named, and only 被 can stand directly before 盗 without a doer. 让 and 叫 need a doer after them.

items.s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu le
items.zh: 我的手机被偷了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu le
items.en: My phone was stolen.
items.why: 被 may be followed directly by the verb when the doer is unknown, and 了 completes it.

items.zh: 感冒药已经吃完了。
items.py: gǎn mào yào yǐ jīng chī wán le
items.en: The cold medicine is all gone.
items.why: A thing plus a result needs no 被 when nothing bad is being described. The extra tile 被 would make it sound odd.

items.zh: 我的充电器叫同学借走了。
items.py: wǒ de chōng diàn qì jiào tóng xué jiè zǒu le
items.en: My charger was borrowed by a classmate.
items.why: In the spoken passive 叫 takes the place of 被, and the doer 同学 must follow it directly before the verb.

items.src_py: gǒu yǎo le wǒ de shǒu
items.task: Make 我的手 the subject with 被.
items.zh: 我的手被狗咬了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu bèi gǒu yǎo le
items.en: The dog bit my hand.
items.why: The receiver 我的手 goes first and 被 + 狗 comes before the verb. 咬 needs 了 to end the sentence.

items.src: 弟弟把我的饮料喝光了。
items.src_py: dì di bǎ wǒ de yǐn liào hē guāng le
items.zh: 我的饮料叫弟弟喝光了。
items.py: wǒ de yǐn liào jiào dì di hē guāng le
items.en: My little brother drank up all my drink.
items.why: The 把 object goes first, 叫 + the old subject follow, and 喝光了 is unchanged. 把 is deleted.

items.s: 我的耳机拿走了被同学。
items.s_py: wǒ de ěr jī ná zǒu le bèi tóng xué
items.zh: 我的耳机被同学拿走了。
items.py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi tóng xué ná zǒu le
items.en: My earphones were taken by a classmate.
items.why: 被 + doer must come before the verb. Putting 'by the classmate' after the verb copies English.

items.zh: 那台平板电脑没被弟弟摔坏。
items.py: nà tái píng bǎn diàn nǎo méi bèi dì di shuāi huài
items.en: That tablet wasn't broken by my little brother.
items.why: As with 把, the negative 没 goes before 被, and the verb phrase 摔坏 stays unchanged at the end without 了.

items.src: 医生会把你的病治好的。
items.src_py: yī shēng huì bǎ nǐ de bìng zhì hǎo de
items.zh: 你的病会被医生治好的。
items.py: nǐ de bìng huì bèi yī shēng zhì hǎo de
items.en: The doctor will cure your illness.
items.why: The modal 会 stays before the marker, which is now 被, and the receiver 你的病 moves to the front.

items.zh: 他的腿被自行车撞伤了。
items.py: tā de tuǐ bèi zì xíng chē zhuàng shāng le
items.en: His leg was hurt when a bicycle hit him.
items.why: 撞 needs the result 伤, and the doer 自行车 goes right after 被, not after the verb.

items.zh: 我的账号昨天被盗了。
items.py: wǒ de zhàng hào zuó tiān bèi dào le
items.en: My account was hacked yesterday.
items.why: With no doer, 被 goes directly before the verb 盗. The time word can come before the receiver or right after it, but not after 被.

items.src: 我的手机被别人拿走了。
items.src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi bié rén ná zǒu le
items.zh: 我的手机被人拿走了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi rén ná zǒu le
items.en: Someone took my phone.
items.why: 人 replaces the named doer as 'someone' and still sits between 被 and the verb.

items.q: 只要备份了，你的文件就___被删除。
items.zh: 只要备份了，你的文件就不会被删除。
items.py: zhǐ yào bèi fèn le nǐ de wén jiàn jiù bù huì bèi shān chú
items.en: As long as you've made a backup, your files won't be deleted.
items.why: A prediction after 只要 uses 不会 before 被. 没有 reports something that did not happen, and 别 is an order that cannot take 文件 as its subject.

items.s: 我的游戏机叫弟弟摔坏了。
items.s_py: wǒ de yóu xì jī jiào dì di shuāi huài le
items.zh: 我的游戏机叫弟弟摔坏了。
items.py: wǒ de yóu xì jī jiào dì di shuāi huài le
items.en: My game console was dropped and broken by my little brother.
items.why: 叫 + doer + verb with result is the spoken passive. The doer 弟弟 is stated, which 叫 requires.

items.zh: 我的流量让孩子用光了。
items.py: wǒ de liú liàng ràng hái zi yòng guāng le
items.en: My data was all used up by the kid.
items.why: 让 works like 被 here: receiver, 让, doer, then verb + result. 孩子 cannot go at the end.

items.q: 弟弟___我的眼镜弄丢了，我很生气。
items.zh: 弟弟把我的眼镜弄丢了，我很生气。
items.py: dì di bǎ wǒ de yǎn jìng nòng diū le wǒ hěn shēng qì
items.en: My little brother lost my glasses and I'm angry.
items.why: Here 弟弟 is the subject doing the losing, so the glasses are the 把 object. 被 would make the brother the thing that got lost.

items.q: 晚饭已经___做好了，快来吃吧。
items.zh: 晚饭已经做好了，快来吃吧。
items.py: wǎn fàn yǐ jīng zuò hǎo le kuài lái chī ba
items.en: Dinner is already made, come and eat.
items.why: Dinner is a thing reported by its result, nothing bad happened and no doer is named, so Chinese uses no 被. Adding 被 would sound odd, as if something was done to it.

items.s_py: shǒu jī yǐ jīng chōng mǎn diàn le
items.zh: 手机已经充满电了。
items.py: shǒu jī yǐ jīng chōng mǎn diàn le
items.en: The phone is already fully charged.
items.why: A thing plus its result with no doer is the natural passive meaning. Adding 被 would not improve it.

items.s_py: yī shēng ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
items.zh: 医生让我多喝水。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
items.en: The doctor told me to drink more water.
items.why: Here 让 means 'tell someone to', and the doctor is the subject. It is not a passive, so no result complement is needed.

items.s: 我的牙被他打掉了一颗。
items.s_py: wǒ de yá bèi tā dǎ diào le yì kē
items.zh: 我的牙被他打掉了一颗。
items.py: wǒ de yá bèi tā dǎ diào le yì kē
items.en: He knocked out one of my teeth.
items.why: A 被 sentence can keep a quantity after the verb. 掉 supplies the result, so the verb is not bare.

items.zh: 他的手机没被小偷偷走。
items.py: tā de shǒu jī méi bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu
items.en: His phone wasn't stolen by a thief.
items.why: 没 negates the whole passive and goes right before 被. It cannot sit between 小偷 and 偷走, and there is no 了 at the end.

items.q: 我的充电器___小王拿走了，你有吗？
items.zh: 我的充电器叫小王拿走了，你有吗？
items.py: wǒ de chōng diàn qì jiào xiǎo wáng ná zǒu le nǐ yǒu ma
items.en: My charger was taken by Xiao Wang. Do you have one?
items.why: 叫 followed by the doer 小王 and a result 走 forms the spoken passive. 把 would make the charger the one taking, and 对 or 向 do not mark a doer.

items.src: 他的眼镜被同学踩坏了。
items.src_py: tā de yǎn jìng bèi tóng xué cǎi huài le
items.zh: 他的眼镜让同学踩坏了。
items.py: tā de yǎn jìng ràng tóng xué cǎi huài le
items.en: His glasses were stepped on and broken by a classmate.
items.why: 让 takes the place of 被 in the same slot, keeping the doer 同学 and the result 踩坏了.

items.s_py: shǒu jī bèi tā bǎ shuāi huài le
items.zh: 手机被他摔坏了。
items.py: shǒu jī bèi tā shuāi huài le
items.en: The phone was dropped and broken by him.
items.why: Once the phone has moved to the front with 被, 把 has nothing left to take. 把 and 被 do not combine for one object.

items.src: 手机里的垃圾文件被他清理干净了。
items.src_py: shǒu jī lǐ de lā jī wén jiàn bèi tā qīng lǐ gān jìng le
items.zh: 他把手机里的垃圾文件清理干净了。
items.py: tā bǎ shǒu jī lǐ de lā jī wén jiàn qīng lǐ gān jìng le
items.en: He cleaned the junk files off his phone.
items.why: Move the doer 他 to the front and the receiver after 把; keep 清理干净了 unchanged.

items.src: 我的充电线被人拿走了。
items.src_py: wǒ de chōng diàn xiàn bèi rén ná zǒu le
items.zh: 我的充电线让人拿走了。
items.py: wǒ de chōng diàn xiàn ràng rén ná zǒu le
items.en: Someone took my charging cable.
items.why: 让 takes 被's place, and 人 must be kept as the doer because 让 cannot be followed straight by the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ de wén jiàn méi bèi shān chú le
items.zh: 我的文件没被删除。
items.py: wǒ de wén jiàn méi bèi shān chú
items.en: My file wasn't deleted.
items.why: 没 already says it did not happen, so the completion 了 cannot be added.

items.zh: 我们的聊天记录不会被别人看到的。
items.py: wǒ men de liáo tiān jì lù bù huì bèi bié rén kàn dào de
items.en: Other people won't see our chat history.
items.why: 不会 is a negative modal and so goes before 被. It cannot follow 别人 and sit before the verb.

items.q: 他的视频被同学传___网上了。
items.zh: 他的视频被同学传到网上了。
items.py: tā de shì pín bèi tóng xué chuán dào wǎng shàng le
items.en: His video was posted online by a classmate.
items.why: 到 + place after the verb says where the video ended up, which completes the 被 sentence. 传给网上 would mean 'give to the internet' and 着 or 过 give no destination.

items.src: 护士已经把药放进他的包里了。
items.src_py: hù shi yǐ jīng bǎ yào fàng jìn tā de bāo lǐ le
items.zh: 药已经被护士放进他的包里了。
items.py: yào yǐ jīng bèi hù shi fàng jìn tā de bāo lǐ le
items.en: The nurse has already put the medicine in his bag.
items.why: 已经 stays in front of the marker. The receiver 药 moves to the very front and 护士 follows 被.

items.src: 孩子把我的平板电脑摔得很碎。
items.src_py: hái zi bǎ wǒ de píng bǎn diàn nǎo shuāi de hěn suì
items.zh: 我的平板电脑被孩子摔得很碎。
items.py: wǒ de píng bǎn diàn nǎo bèi hái zi shuāi de hěn suì
items.en: The child dropped my tablet and it's smashed.
items.why: The 得 description after the verb is kept in the passive. The tablet goes first and 孩子 follows 被.

items.q: 他的手被门夹___了。
items.zh: 他的手被门夹伤了。
items.py: tā de shǒu bèi mén jiā shāng le
items.en: His hand got hurt when the door pinched it.
items.why: 夹 needs a result, and 伤 says what happened to the hand. 夹过了 would only mean it was pinched at some point, not that it was hurt.

items.q: 我的新手机___同学借走了。
items.zh: 我的新手机让同学借走了。
items.py: wǒ de xīn shǒu jī ràng tóng xué jiè zǒu le
items.en: My new phone was borrowed by a classmate.
items.why: Spoken Chinese can use 让 as the passive marker, with the doer 同学 right after it and a result 走 on the verb. 把 would make the phone do the borrowing.

items.zh: 我的照片被朋友发到网上了。
items.py: wǒ de zhào piàn bèi péng you fā dào wǎng shàng le
items.en: My photo was posted online by a friend.
items.why: 被 + 朋友 must precede the verb 发到; 到 + 网上 then says where it went. A 被 phrase after the verb is the English habit.

items.src_py: dì di hē wán le wǒ de niú nǎi
items.task: Make 我的牛奶 the subject with 被.
items.zh: 我的牛奶被弟弟喝完了。
items.py: wǒ de niú nǎi bèi dì di hē wán le
items.en: My little brother drank up my milk.
items.why: The object moves to the front, 被 + doer goes before the verb, and 喝完了 keeps its result.

items.q: 我的饮料让___喝光了。
items.zh: 我的饮料让人喝光了。
items.py: wǒ de yǐn liào ràng rén hē guāng le
items.en: Someone drank up all my drink.
items.why: 让 as a passive marker must be followed by a doer, even if it is only 人 'someone'. With nothing after it, 让 has no one to be the doer.

items.src_py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi xiǎo tōu tōu le
items.zh: 我的耳机被偷了。
items.py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi tōu le
items.en: My earphones were stolen.
items.why: With 被 the doer can simply be dropped, so the verb comes right after 被.

items.src: 妹妹把我的耳机弄丢了。
items.src_py: mèi mei bǎ wǒ de ěr jī nòng diū le
items.zh: 我的耳机被妹妹弄丢了。
items.py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi mèi mei nòng diū le
items.en: My little sister lost my earphones.
items.why: The 把 object becomes the subject, the 把 subject goes after 被, and 把 disappears.

items.q: 我的屏幕被弟弟摔___很碎。
items.zh: 我的屏幕被弟弟摔得很碎。
items.py: wǒ de píng mù bèi dì di shuāi de hěn suì
items.en: My little brother dropped my screen and it's all cracked.
items.why: To describe the state something was left in, add 得 after the verb. 地 goes before a verb and 的 before a noun.

items.src: 他把我气得说不出话来。
items.src_py: tā bǎ wǒ qì de shuō bù chū huà lái
items.zh: 我被他气得说不出话来。
items.py: wǒ bèi tā qì de shuō bù chū huà lái
items.en: He made me so angry I couldn't speak.
items.why: The 得 description is kept. The object 我 moves to the front and the doer 他 follows 被.

items.q: 放心，你的照片___会被别人看到的。
items.zh: 放心，你的照片不会被别人看到的。
items.py: fàng xīn nǐ de zhào piàn bù huì bèi bié rén kàn dào de
items.en: Relax, other people won't see your photos.
items.why: A prediction is negated with 不会, and it comes before 被. 没 is for past events and 别 is a command, so neither fits with 会.

items.q: 我的充电线被猫___咬坏了。
items.zh: 我的充电线被猫咬坏了。
items.py: wǒ de chōng diàn xiàn bèi māo yǎo huài le
items.en: My charging cable got chewed up by the cat.
items.why: Once the object has moved to the front with 被, nothing is left for 把 to do. 把 and 被 never both appear for the same object.

items.s_py: wǒ de zhào piàn bèi méi shān chú
items.zh: 我的照片没被删除。
items.py: wǒ de zhào piàn méi bèi shān chú
items.en: My photos weren't deleted.
items.why: 没 goes before 被, not between 被 and the verb.

items.src_py: tā méi bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī nòng huài
items.zh: 我的手机没被他弄坏。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi tā nòng huài
items.en: He didn't break my phone.
items.why: The negative stays in front of the marker, now 被, and the final verb phrase is unchanged with no 了 added.

items.q: 他被救护车送___医院，医生马上给他做了检查。
items.zh: 他被救护车送到医院，医生马上给他做了检查。
items.py: tā bèi jiù hù chē sòng dào yī yuàn yī shēng mǎ shàng gěi tā zuò le jiǎn chá
items.en: He was taken to the hospital by ambulance, and the doctor examined him right away.
items.why: 到 + place states where he was taken, which completes the verb. 送给医院 would mean giving him to the hospital as a present.

items.zh: 你的体检报告已经出来了。
items.py: nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào yǐ jīng chū lái le
items.en: Your checkup report is already out.
items.why: The report is a thing and nobody did anything to it in this sentence, so there is no 被. 被出来 is not a possible phrase.
